text:
samir: Heads up - RC build failing and it's a weird combo: typegen regen diff + sample-app onboarding auth/retry flakes. Anyone free to triage?
lee: Link?
samir: https://ci.internal/17899 job 12 (auth tests failing intermittently)
samir: Failure excerpt:
```
Type-hash mismatch -> packages/js-sdk/dist/index.d.ts differs
And then sample-app auth test: Error: 401 unauthorized -> retry exhausted
```
lee: Hmm, could the regenerated types have changed a nullable field to optional which causes the client to serialize a missing field and server to reject? That would hit auth retry logic if token refresh path gets exercised.
samir: Good call. The diff shows CreateSession shape changed ordering AND `expiresAt` went from required -> optional in generated types, but spec didn't change. Looks like generator update changed required heuristics.
dx-bot: Suggested fixes: 1) force generator config to preserve "required" semantics (pin codegen flags), 2) pin the previous generator version, 3) revert to previous type-hash and investigate generator upgrade in a follow-up.
samir: We must avoid spec edits. Also semver guard is blocking publish: CHANGELOG entry currently marked "minor". This is non-user-facing SDK parity + test-stability fix -> should be a patch.
lee: Plan: locally run `yarn tools:typegen --generator-version=2.3.1 --preserve-required && yarn sample-app:test` to reproduce. If that matches CI, open PR with: stable generator config, regenerated types, updated type-hash, and changelog amended to "patch: SDK regen parity & auth test stabilization".
release-ops: If CI still flakes after PR, add a release-exception request with details: root cause generator heuristics change leading to optional/required mismatch and transient auth retry path. We'll need a follow-up ticket to audit generator upgrades across SDKs.
ci-bot: publish-gate: blocked - metadata/typehash mismatch (see https://ci.internal/reports/17899).
samir: I'll run the local commands now and post before/after diffs. Lee, please review changelog blurb when the PR is up.
lee: will do. Also recommend cc'ing infra-team in the PR so they can watch the auth retry side-effects.
samir: thanks - opening PR in ~20m. If this fixes pipeline we'll roll the RC. :crossed_fingers:
